# Synthetic Respiratory Observation Workflow

## Intake Signals
This generated fixture describes a training-only observation workflow for breathing comfort signals in a simulated skills lab. It is not a care instruction and not an authority source.

## Observation Steps
1. Confirm the synthetic scenario label before any note is created.
2. Observe breathing rhythm, visible effort, and conversation comfort using neutral training language.
3. Record only synthetic scenario findings and avoid personal identifiers.
4. Escalate the training exercise to a human reviewer when information is incomplete.

## Table-Like Checklist
| item | synthetic observation |
| rhythm | steady or irregular in the simulated script |
| effort | relaxed or increased in the simulated script |
| review | always requires human training review |

## Safety Boundary
The fixture supports lexical retrieval tests only. It must not be used for clinical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or registry activation.
